newsitem.title: USA: E-Z Serve says Q4 could be hurt by costs.
newsitem.headline: E-Z Serve says Q4 could be hurt by costs.

text.p: E-Z Serve Corp said on Friday that third quarter results were hurt by the high cost of crude oil and that without relief, the fourth quarter will also be hurt.
E-Z Serve, a distributor of motor fuels, said the high cost of crude dramatically increased the cost of gasoline to the company.
The company said that competitive market conditions have not permitted the increase to be passed on to the consumer.
E-Z Serve reported third quarter earnings of $0.02 a share, compared with $0.03 a share a year earlier.
